about: [O3] after the critic: the review frames - a beat cop punched first, the fist fight on (O4's crowd brawl); the station wake facing the door; the roadblock's beacons under a lamp from 75 m.

steps.eval: (() => { const E = G.eye, y = G.controller.yaw, fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); window.__o3cop = G.people.dbgCop(E.x + fx * 5, E.z + fz * 5, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); return 1; })()

steps.look: (() => { const C = G.controller, c = window.__o3cop; const want = Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - G.eye.x), -(c.pos.z - G.eye.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / 0.0021), Math.round(-(-0.05 - C.pitch) / 0.0021)]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.city.places, s = P.byId.get('police'); if (P.seat) P.stand(); P.inside = null; P.level = 0; const o = s.frame.w(0, 3.2); G.controller.setPose(o.x, o.z, s.frame.yaw(0) + Math.PI, -0.05); return 1; })()
(() => { const P = G.people; P.dbgClear(); P.dbgAtCar(); return 1; })()
